text: ok so i need it to only be on top of the floor, because the option of both is really annoying and im getting walls mismatched because of it
resolution: Changed hmsc-int build wall snapping so floor/roof top anchoring only happens when the crosshair hits the actual top face. Side-face hits on a floor/roof and ground hits beside a floor perimeter now return no floor-top wall placement, removing the ambiguous alternate path that caused wall mismatches. Updated snap tests and build capture notes; targeted build-snap suite passes 15/15 and the hmsc-int entry bundles with repo aliases. No commit made.
